scenario: [LSER.16.9] / [LSER.14.1]: `first` and `last` over `all_time` are the earliest and the newest sample ever absorbed for the identity, in the slot's own type, on the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1] -- on a window they ride SeriesBackendFifoDeque instead). Values 3, 5, 8 one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]): cold is `null` (no log), then [3] -> 3 and 3, [3, 5] -> 3 and 5, [3, 5, 8] -> 3 and 8. Drives libds `welford_ewma.c`'s `typed_first` / `typed_prev` and the Mercury `ds.series` `agg_first` / `agg_last` over the all-time samples.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    first, last all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.first is not null
->
    log info "first {s.first} last {s.last}"
